taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Cargo build scripts/proc macros and build-time authority
controls.source_trace: Trace lower-trust dependency/source selection into code executed during build, separating ordinary data dependencies from executable build hooks.
controls.implementation_branch: Build scripts and procedural macros execute on the build host even when the final target is a different architecture. Review registry/git/path source selection and lockfile revision with the build sandbox. A crate declaring a build script is not itself malicious; demonstrate an untrusted source gaining capabilities outside the declared build trust policy.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect inert owned fixtures or run only a reviewed local stub that writes a harmless marker under bounded permissions.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A dependency capable of build-time code execution is not an exploit when it is intentionally trusted and correctly sourced.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain sources and build authority, verify provenance and preserve legitimate build-script functionality.
